route_note: A `vertex/` prefix is a routing decision inside the consumer repository, not a distinct model. Both routes retire together, so a migration that only fixes the bare identifiers leaves Vertex-routed callers broken.
replacement_resolution_rule: The provider identifier is a claim, not a usable constant. Resolve it against the target repository's own model catalog and its installed SDK before writing it into code. At the pinned Egaki baseline the resolvable identifier is `gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview`; the bare provider identifier exits with `Unknown model`.

not_covered.reason: Third-party fal.ai-hosted model whose id merely contains the substring `imagen4`. Not a Google first-party endpoint and not covered by this retirement. Editing it is an unnecessary change.

immutable_paths.reason: A changelog records what shipped. Rewriting history to remove a retired identifier falsifies the record; add a new entry instead.
